package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/endpoint"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/auth"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/web"
)

type row struct{ Value int64 }
type other struct{ Value int64 }

var invalid endpoint.Input[row] = endpoint.Resolve(endpoint.PathInt64("id"), func(_ *web.Request, _ auth.Principal, id int64) (other, error) { return other{Value: id}, nil })
